items.title: AstraZeneca Data Breach – LAPSUS$ Group Allegedly Claims Access to Internal Data
items.description: The notorious hacking collective LAPSUS$ has resurfaced, allegedly claiming responsibility for a significant data breach involving the multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company AstraZeneca.
